milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The potted blue orchid is placed at spawn-relative (8, 1, 10) inside an oak plank building. The player must navigate to within 5 blocks and face the orchid (within 60°), confirming they actually entered the building and visually located the target among decoy pots (dandelion, poppy, empty pot) placed elsewhere in the scene.
